acceptance_predicates.description: Project init creates canonical config, results, and catalogs locations.
A second init preserves valid user data and reports no destructive action.
Conflicting files, traversal, and unsafe symlinks are rejected without writes outside the project.
Default output gives concise next commands and `--json` returns the same facts structurally.

definition_of_done: Disposable-directory and locked workspace tests pass on the exact reviewed head

gates.description: Fresh, repeat, conflict, partial, and symlink cases pass.
Human and JSON output contracts pass.
